subject: maths
question: When an article is sold for ₹242.50, there is a loss of 3%. What will be the selling price, if the article is sold at a gain of 13%?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let CP = 100 units

⇒ 97 units = 242.50

⇒ 1 unit = 2.5

⇒ CP = 100 units = 250

SP = 250 x 113/100 = 282.50
